WEATHER UPDATE: PAGASA has issued a Red Warning Level for Metro Manila, Bataan, and parts of Rizal (Rodriguez, San Mateo, Cainta, Antipolo, Taytay) as of 11:00 PM, 21 July 2025. This means serious flooding is expected in flood-prone areas due to heavy rains from the Southwest Monsoon.

Orange Warning is up in Cavite, Bulacan, Pampanga, Zambales, Laguna, Batangas, and parts of eastern Rizal, while Yellow Warning is raised in Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, and Quezon.

Stay safe, KaTribu!

[4:53PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic descending from CMS Bridge towards Offin Canal is experiencing slow movement due to ongoing market activities and high pedestrian influx. However, traffic improves immediately after Offin Canal heading towards Eko Bridge by the NEPA office, where movement is smooth.

Traffic along Eko Bridge by NEPA inward CMS Bridge is currently flowing well. Similarly, the descent from Eko Bridge towards Elegbeta Mini Stadium and Ebute Ero Market is moving smoothly at this time.

Traffic descending from Carter Bridge into Ebute Ero Market, through Leventis and UBA Roundabout, connecting both inner and outer Marina routes, is also free-flowing.

However, there is slow movement along Broad Street extending to the Apongbon underbridge, particularly towards the Offin Canal Market axis.

At present, there are no major obstructions, and personnel are on ground managing traffic effectively.

#FollowLASTMA
